items.exampleEn: The poster advertises a free concert in the park.
items.exampleZh: 這張海報宣傳公園裡的一場免費音樂會。

items.exampleEn: He thought aloud while he solved the problem.
items.exampleZh: 他一邊解題，一邊把想法說出來。

items.exampleEn: Telecommunications have changed how people work.
items.exampleZh: 電信科技改變了人們工作的方式。

items.exampleEn: The company's new slogan is short and easy to remember.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司的新標語簡短又好記。

items.exampleEn: Visually, the two phones look the same.
items.exampleZh: 從外觀上看，這兩支手機一模一樣。

items.exampleEn: The coach always carries a whistle.
items.exampleZh: 教練總是帶著一個哨子。

items.exampleEn: His travel blog has thousands of readers.
items.exampleZh: 他的旅遊部落格有好幾千個讀者。

items.exampleEn: The inscription on the old stone is hard to read.
items.exampleZh: 那塊古老石頭上的銘文很難看懂。

items.sentenceEn: Our team needs a new slogan.
items.sentenceZh: 我們隊需要一個新口號。

items.audioEn: Please read the instructions aloud so everyone can hear.
items.audioZh: 請把說明大聲念出來，讓大家都聽得到。
items.questionZh: 為什麼要大聲念出說明？
options: So the whole group can hear.
Because the teacher can't hear well.
Because it is a reading test.
Because the room is very dark.

items.sentenceEn: My little brother likes to read stories aloud.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟喜歡大聲朗讀故事。

items.sentenceEn: Many people get jobs in telecommunications.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人在電信業找到工作。

items.stemEn: The referee blew his ____ to end the game.
Many companies ____ their products on TV and online.
items.stemZh: 很多公司在電視和網路上宣傳產品。

items.passageEn: My cousin works in telecommunications, but in her free time, she writes a blog about old buildings. Last month, she wrote about an old train station. Above its door, there is an inscription that says, "Welcome, travelers." She read it aloud in a short video for her readers. She also found the station's old slogan, painted on a wall: "Fast and Safe." The station is visually beautiful, with high windows and colorful tiles. Every morning at seven, a worker still blows a whistle. Now a company wants to advertise its products there, but my cousin hopes the station will stay as it is.
items.passageZh: 我的表親在電信業工作，空閒時會寫一個介紹老建築的部落格。上個月，她寫了一座老火車站。車站門上有一段題字，寫著「歡迎各位旅客」。她在一支短片裡為讀者把它大聲念出來。她也找到車站以前的標語，漆在一面牆上：「快速又安全」。這座車站在視覺上很美，有高高的窗戶和色彩繽紛的磁磚。每天早上七點，還有一位員工會吹哨子。現在有一家公司想在那裡宣傳產品，但我的表親希望車站能保持原樣。

options: 寫關於老建築的部落格

items.promptZh: 他們在網路上宣傳新餐廳。
referenceEn: They advertised their new restaurant online.
They advertised the new restaurant on the internet.
rubricZh: advertise 表示「宣傳、刊登廣告」，例如 advertise a restaurant 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 blog 造一個句子，說說你常看或想寫的部落格。
referenceEn: I read a blog about football every day.
I want to start a blog about my cat.
rubricZh: blog 表示「部落格」，可數名詞，例如 read a blog、start a blog 等說法
說的是自己的習慣或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
